svg.title: Inversion: which way is positive?
svg.desc: Animated. Two steering modules, seen from above, each get a positive output toward a target counter-clockwise of the wheel. Left, with the sign wrong, the positive output turns the wheel clockwise, away from the target, and it keeps spinning faster: it runs away, the error only grows. Right, with the sign flipped, the same positive output turns the wheel counter-clockwise onto the target. Every motor and encoder has a direction; one wrong sign and a module runs away or fights the others. The hand check turns each part by hand, with nothing powered, and checks each sign agrees with the code.
svg.text: The code expects positive output to turn the module counter-clockwise.
Runs away: the error only grows.
